status: draft — read from the Regulations by the build; quotes checked against the PDF by a test; nobody has approved the list

regulation.title: UPERC (Multi Year Tariff for Distribution) Regulations, 2025

scope: What these Regulations require a true-up, APR or ARR petition to contain or to have been done (Regs. 4–8).  Not the Commission's list of formats: Regs. 4.2, 5.1 and 6.1 refer to formats 'as may be prescribed by the Commission', and that prescription is not in these Regulations.

items.requirement: True-up FY2024-25, APR FY2025-26 and ARR FY2026-27 filed by 30 November 2025 (the 2019 Regulations govern the true-up's content; the date is these Regulations')

evidence.ref: Verified at [A-Za-z ]+ on this date \d{1,2}\w{0,2} day of \w+, 20\d\d
evidence.why: the affidavit's verification date — the petition's date as sworn
an extension the petition cites (the Commission's letter of 25.11.2025 — the letter itself is not among the documents)

items.note: Reg. 6.1's proviso: a true-up filed after the Reg. 4.1 date gets no carrying cost on a gap for the delay — whether the extension covers it is the reviewer's

items.quote: The Licensee shall submit the data regarding the above as per guidelines and formats prescribed and added/ amended from time to time by the Commission.
items.requirement: Data in the formats the Commission prescribes

evidence.why: the petitioner's own index of formats — the Commission's list is not in these Regulations (Reg. 4.2, 5.1 and 6.1 refer to formats 'as may be prescribed')

items.quote: after due authorization by the Board of Directors or by any Committee/person authorised by the Board in this regard
items.requirement: Authorisation by the Board (or its delegate)

evidence.ref: Resolution passed by the Board of Directors dated \d\d\.\d\d\.20\d\d
evidence.why: Form-1 cites the Board resolution, attached as its Appendix I(b)
the resolution and the letter of authorisation themselves (Form-1's Appendix I(a) and I(b))

items.quote: electronically on e-filing portal of the Commission
items.requirement: Filed on the Commission's e-filing portal, digitally signed by the authorised representative

evidence.why: a filing event and a signature: the documents as provided (DOCX and XLSX copies) cannot show either

items.quote: Hard copies of the Petition shall also be filed
items.requirement: Hard copies with the fees under the Fee and Fines Regulations

evidence.why: hard copies and the fee are not in the documents

items.quote: publish a Public Notice in at least two English and two Hindi daily newspapers
items.requirement: Public notice within three working days of admittance; the petition and computations on the website, text-searchable or as spreadsheets

evidence.why: after admittance — the Commission's order records it (the FY2026-27 order describes the public process)

items.quote: together with the Accounting Statements, extracts of books of account
items.requirement: True-up with the Accounting Statements and extracts of books of account

evidence.why: the trial balance — extracts of the books

items.quote: prepared in compliance of the Electricity Distribution (Accounts and Additional Disclosure) Rules, 2024
items.requirement: Accounting Statements under the Accounts and Additional Disclosure Rules 2024

evidence.ref: Company will ensure compliance with the said Rules from FY 20\d\d-\d\d onwards
evidence.why: NPCL's statement in its compliance report (Appendix VII) — not the Commission's directive quoted above it

items.note: NPCL states the detailed disclosures are 'being complied' in the FY2024-25 accounts and that the Rules (as amended in 2025, in force from 01.04.2026) will be complied with from FY2026-27 — whether that meets Reg. 6.4 for the true-up year is the reviewer's (A59).  The audited accounts (a PDF not in this copy of the package) are where compliance shows.

items.quote: submit a statement on the status of compliance to the directives issued by the Commission in the previous Tariff Order
items.requirement: Statement of compliance with the Commission's directives

items.quote: together with the audited/ provisional Accounting Statements
items.requirement: APR with audited or provisional accounting statements

evidence.why: the current year's actuals for six months (Reg. 3.1(i))

items.quote: category/ sub-category wise number of consumers, connected load, load factor and sales projections
items.requirement: Category-wise consumers, connected load, load factor and sales projections

evidence.why: billing determinants for the ARR year
load factor — no format carries it; a mention only

items.quote: Power Procurement Plan (renewable energy and non-renewable energy) and forecasting
items.requirement: Power procurement plan, renewable and other

items.quote: Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO) planning and forecasting

items.requirement: Distribution loss trajectory (with the AT&C trajectory agreed under a national scheme, if any)

items.quote: Capital Investment Plan, financing plan and physical targets, equity, grants, etc.
items.requirement: Capital investment plan, financing plan, physical targets, equity and grants

evidence.ref: 49. Annexure-38- Details of CAPEX for FY 2026-27

items.quote: status of metering, feeder level/ distribution transformer metering, diversity factor
items.requirement: Status of metering, feeder and DT metering, diversity factors by category

evidence.why: diversity factor — no format carries it; a mention only

items.quote: expected revenue from the existing Tariff
items.requirement: Revenue at the existing tariff and the proposed tariff, category-wise

evidence.why: the existing and proposed rate schedule
